title: Corporate Car Rental
summary: Daily, weekly, monthly and long-term rentals with dedicated fleets and consolidated invoicing.
body:
From a single executive sedan on a monthly contract to a dedicated multi-vehicle fleet assigned to your organization for years, corporate rental is the core of what we have done since 1997.

- Daily, weekly, monthly and long-term contracts
- Dedicated vehicles and drivers assigned to your account
- Consolidated monthly invoicing with agreed credit terms
- Replacement vehicles during maintenance — your operations never stop
- A dedicated account manager who knows your movement patterns

Every vehicle is comprehensively insured, GPS-tracked, and maintained on a documented schedule. Ask us for a proposal — most corporate fleets are contracted within a week.

title: Staff Transportation
summary: Pick & drop and shift transport on fixed company contracts — vans, coasters and route planning included.
body:
Reliable staff transport is an operational commitment, not just a vehicle. We run daily pick & drop and shift-based routes for offices, factories, call centres and airlines.

- Route design and optimisation for your staff addresses
- Fixed monthly contracts with Hi-Ace vans and Coaster buses
- Attendance and tracking reports for HR
- Trained, vetted drivers on consistent routes
- Night-shift and female-staff transport protocols

Shift changes at midnight or 6 a.m. are exactly where our 24/7 operations room earns its keep.

title: Airline Crew Transportation
summary: 24/7 crew dispatch and flight-operation support — we are PIA's cockpit crew transport contractor.
body:
## Proven at the national flag carrier

Shani Travels is the contracted cockpit crew transport provider for **Pakistan International Airlines** through our Karachi office at Jinnah International Airport (JIAP). Every day, our vehicles and dispatch team move flight crews between the airport, hotels and residences against hard flight-operation deadlines.

What that contract has taught us is what every airline needs:

- **24/7 dispatch desk** synchronised with flight schedules, delays and roster changes
- Punctuality measured against report times, not traffic excuses
- Clean, comfortable vehicles that respect crew rest requirements
- Vetted, badged drivers familiar with airport security procedures
- Instant replacement vehicles — a crew never waits on a breakdown

If your airline, charter operation or ground handler needs crew movement it can stop thinking about, we are the contractor that already does this for the national carrier.

title: Government & Development Sector Transport
summary: Registered, tax-compliant transport for ministries, departments and development programmes.
body:
Public-sector procurement demands documentation, and we have it: registered with the Registrar of Firms, NTN and GST compliant, with nearly three decades of references from government and development-sector programmes.

- Fleet provision for departments, projects and visiting delegations
- Election-mission and census-scale deployments — we have done both
- Transparent per-vehicle billing that survives audit
- Provincial coverage through our 8-city office network
- Protocol vehicles for official movements

From a single ministry sedan to a hundred-vehicle field deployment, the paperwork and the vehicles are equally in order.

title: NGO & International Organization Transport
summary: Donor-project fleets with field-ready 4x4s, provincial reach and the compliance NGOs require.
body:
NGOs and international organizations have been our anchor clients since the early 2000s — from earthquake response to election observation to multi-year development programmes.

- Field-ready double-cabin 4x4s and SUVs for provincial operations
- Journey management with GPS tracking and a 24/7 operations room
- Drivers vetted, trained and inducted on humanitarian codes of conduct
- Provincial backup vehicles so field plans survive breakdowns
- Documentation that satisfies donor compliance and audit requirements

Organizations including IOM, Concern Worldwide and USAID-funded programmes have put their teams in our vehicles across every province of Pakistan.

title: Project & Site Transportation
summary: Oil & gas, construction, engineering and infrastructure — crews, equipment and HSE discipline.
body:
Remote sites break ordinary transport arrangements. Project transportation is a different discipline: HSE inductions, journey management plans, defensive-driving-trained drivers, and vehicles specified for the terrain.

- Double-cabin 4x4s with roll cages for field operations
- Crew-change runs on fixed schedules, day and night
- Logistics trucks for equipment and material movement
- Pre-trip inspections documented for every departure
- Incident reporting aligned with your HSE system

Oil & gas operators, construction joint ventures and engineering consultancies run multi-year site fleets with us because the discipline holds up in month eighteen, not just week one.

title: Event Transportation
summary: Conferences, delegations, corporate events and weddings — coordinated multi-vehicle movements.
body:
Moving two hundred delegates between an airport, three hotels and a convention centre is choreography. We plan it, staff it and run it.

- Delegation fleets: executive sedans, SUVs, coasters and buses under one coordinator
- Airport meet & greet with named signage
- Wedding cars decorated to your theme, with formally dressed chauffeurs
- Guest shuttles on published schedules
- On-site transport desk for large events

One contract, one coordinator, one accountable operator — however many vehicles the event needs.

title: Airport Transfers
summary: Punctual pickups and drop-offs for every flight — live tracking, meet & greet, 24/7.
body:
Flight delayed? No problem — we track your flight in real time and adjust the pickup accordingly.

- Live flight tracking on every airport booking
- Meet & greet at arrivals with named signage
- Fixed, transparent transfer pricing per vehicle
- 24/7 availability at all major Pakistani airports
- Child seats and extra luggage space on request

Book online in minutes; our team confirms by phone or WhatsApp.

title: Intercity Travel
summary: Comfortable chauffeur-driven point-to-point journeys between all major cities.
body:
Travelling between Islamabad, Lahore, Karachi, Peshawar or beyond? Book a chauffeur-driven sedan or SUV for a comfortable, direct door-to-door journey.

- Door-to-door service between any two cities
- Experienced highway drivers on familiar routes
- Fixed transparent fares agreed before departure
- Rest stops planned to your preference
- One-way and return options

For groups, our Grand Cabin vans and coasters make the same journeys together.

title: Tourism & Leisure
summary: Family and business tours, Northern Areas expeditions and custom packages with mountain-route drivers.
body:
Hunza, Skardu, Naran, Swat — Pakistan's north rewards travellers who arrive with the right vehicle and the right driver.

- Custom multi-day itineraries built around your dates
- Experienced mountain-route drivers who know every pass
- 4x4s and SUVs specified for northern terrain
- Family tours, honeymoon packages and business retreats
- Full route planning, hotel coordination and flexible stops

Tell us where you want to wake up; we will plan the road that gets you there.

title: Executive & VIP Transport
summary: Mercedes, BMW and flagship SUVs with protocol-trained chauffeurs for leadership and delegations.
body:
When the passenger is the principal, the vehicle and the driver are part of the protocol.

- Executive delegate fleet: Mercedes C/S-Class, BMW 5–7 Series, Toyota Crown, Honda Accord
- Flagship SUVs: Land Cruiser V8, LX and Prado
- Protocol-trained, formally dressed chauffeurs
- Route reconnaissance and timing rehearsals for formal movements
- Discretion and confidentiality as standard

Board chairs, ministers, ambassadors and visiting executives are moved on exactly this fleet every week.

title: Secure & Specialized Transport
summary: B-6 armored fleet with security-trained drivers and escort coordination for elevated-threat movements.
body:
For principals and cargo that face genuine threat, we operate a **B-6 armored fleet** — REVO, Prado, Fortuner and Land Cruiser V8 — supported by procedures, not just steel.

- B-6 ballistic protection as our fleet standard
- Security-trained drivers with defensive and evasive driving instruction
- Convoy and escort coordination with your security provider
- Journey management through the 24/7 Operations Control Room
- Route planning, alternates and check-in protocols on every movement

Embassies, missions and corporate security teams engage this capability under standing contracts. See our full [Safety & Security protocol](/safety).

title: Self-Drive Rental
summary: Drive yourself — verified handover, transparent terms and a joint inspection that protects you too.
body:
Prefer to drive yourself? Selected vehicles from our fleet are available for self-drive rental under a clear, documented process.

- Original CNIC/passport and valid driving licence verified at pickup — nothing uploaded online
- Joint handover inspection: condition, fuel and mileage photographed together
- Transparent permitted-use terms and security deposit
- 24/7 breakdown support while you drive
- Joint return inspection closes the rental cleanly

See the full process, requirements and eligible vehicles on our [Self-Drive page](/self-drive).
